name: SupaEasy
summary: No-code Shopify Functions generator (by Nextools): build and migrate custom discount, checkout, payment, shipping and validation logic from the Shopify Admin, with a migrator for deprecated Scripts and an AI generator that writes functions from a plain-language brief.
best_for: Shopify merchants, especially non-Plus stores, who want custom discount, checkout, payment and shipping logic without hiring a developer, and above all those forced to migrate deprecated Shopify Scripts to Functions before the cutoff
skip_if: you only need a simple volume discount (a dedicated discount app is cheaper), you are comfortable writing Shopify Functions in code yourself, or you will not pay $99 a month to use the AI generator on a live store: the free plan runs on a dev store only
honest_knock: Two things the marketing glosses over. First, the 'free' plan is development-stores only, so any live use is paid, and the AI generator that headlines the app is not in Premium ($49) but in Advanced ($99), plus AI credits bought separately ($25 per 50), so the AI promise realistically costs $99+ a month. Second, the rating is suspiciously spotless: 5.0 across 233 reviews, all five-star, on the App Store listing on 29 September 2026, and the praise dwells on fast human support (Andrea, Fabio) more than on the no-code AI running unattended, which hints the tool can need hand-holding.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/supaeasy and in our own test that day; earlier: verified 2026-08-28 on apps.shopify.com/supaeasy and supaeasy.com/pricing; re-verified 2026-10-22 on both) A free plan plus four paid monthly tiers. The catch is in the free plan: it works only on a development store, not a live one. Starter is $29 a month ($278 a year), Premium is $49 a month ($470 a year) and Advanced is $99 a month ($950 a year), each with a 7-day trial on the App Store listing, which bills in USD; Ultimate is $399 a month ($3,830 a year) on the vendor's own pricing page and is not on the listing. Starter is new since our 16 October check: it covers the flow interface for conditional discounts, payment-gateway and delivery-rate rules, validation functions and import/export between stores. The headline feature — the AI Functions Generator, which writes a function from a plain-language description — does not appear until Advanced at $99, alongside the Scripts Editor and the Functions Wizard, and the App Store listing prices AI credits for it separately: $25 per 50, $40 per 100 or $149 per 500. So using SupaEasy the way it markets itself, on a live store, realistically starts at $99 a month. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing (now 239 reviews at 5.0) still carries the FREE DEV STORE plan, with unlimited payment, delivery and discount customizations for testing and API access, and the paid plans at the amounts above, with the AI credit packs. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the app did not show that free plan: it opened with “No active plan” and a setup list asking us to subscribe, its billing screen offered only Starter $29, Premium $49 and Advanced $99 a month, each with a 7 day trial, with a monthly and an annual tab (annual marked as a 20% saving) and a coupon field, and the Flow and Wizard options did nothing until a plan was chosen. Shopify's approval screen for Starter read $29 every 30 days after a 7 day trial ending 24 November, with an Add payment method row and Approve greyed out; it did not carry the line saying the charge would not be billed, so we did not approve it. So on our development store the listing's free dev store plan was not available inside the app.

compare_with.name: Shopify Functions
compare_with.why: SupaEasy is a no-code layer over Shopify Functions: the same platform capability a developer would code by hand. With engineering time, native Functions cost nothing but your developer's hours; SupaEasy is for merchants who would rather describe the logic than write it, and who need the Scripts migrator. Weigh the subscription against a freelancer's one-off build

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session installed SupaEasy on a Shopify development store. Without a plan the function builders Flow and Wizard did not open, the billing page offered only paid plans and no free dev store plan, and the Shopify approval screen for Starter asked for a payment method, so no rule was made. The app was uninstalled; nothing was paid. Install: the Install button on the App Store led twice to the list of apps without installing. The app was installed through its address in the admin: the dialog Install app (staff and contributor data; discounts and Shopify Functions) was approved at about 22:35. The app opened as SupaEasy (Create next level customizations using Shopify Functions). Core action NOT DONE: the home page showed Let's get you started 0 / 2 with Subscribe to a plan and Explore functions, and Current plan: No active plan. Explore functions opened Choose how to create your function (Flow, Wizard, Editor, API); a click on Flow or Wizard did nothing without a plan, with no screen and no error. The AI Functions Generator was not reached. Plans in the app: Starter Plan $29, Premium Plan $49 and Advanced Plan $99, each with Trial for 7 days included, tabs Monthly, Annual (SAVE 20%) and Copilot Credits, and an Insert coupon button. The FREE DEV STORE plan from the listing was not among the plan cards. Checkout: Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription: STARTER PLAN, $29,00 USD every 30 days, a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov, total $29,00 due 24 Nov, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The line You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen, so nothing was approved, no card was entered and Cancel was clicked. Cancelling: no subscription existed. The app was uninstalled with the reason Testing multiple apps and the message You've successfully uninstalled SupaEasy. Clean up: no subscription, no rule and no order were made; our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The Install button on the listing did not install for our test tool, so the app was installed from its admin address; without a plan a click on Flow or Wizard did nothing, with no message; the listing names a free dev store plan that the billing page in the app did not show.
